name: Object-Oriented Programming
description: Inheritance, MRO, polymorphism, properties and advanced class mechanics.

name: Code Style — PEP 8
description: Naming conventions, imports, line length and formatting rules.

name: The Zen of Python — PEP 20
description: The guiding principles for writing idiomatic Python.

name: Docstrings — PEP 257
description: Conventions for writing module, class and function docstrings.

name: Typing — Type Hints
description: Static type annotations: PEP 484 type hints, the typing module, PEP 613 explicit type aliases, and the modern `type` statement (PEP 695).

name: Types as Classes — PEP 252
description: Making types look more like classes: introspection APIs and attribute descriptors — plus the class-creation machinery that followed (PEP 3115 metaclasses, PEP 487 `__init_subclass__` / `__set_name__`).

name: Subtyping Built-in Types — PEP 253
description: Metatypes, subtyping built-in types, multiple inheritance and MRO.

name: Generators & Iterators
description: Iterator protocol, generator functions, yield expressions, generator expressions and async generators (PEP 234, PEP 255, language reference).

name: GUI Programming
description: Graphical user interface programming in Python: Tkinter, event-driven programming, widgets, geometry managers and event handling.

name: File Processing
description: Reading, writing and managing text, binary and structured data files in Python.
